none: PAS CAM-18B753: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD367-375
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM] ; D/ [...] GRATIANVS AVGG AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD367-375. Mint is Lyon, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows emperor advancing right, dragging captive. See (as) LRBC, p.52, no.321 var. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] GRATIANVS AVGG AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: O/F II//LVGS. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.22g, diameter is 16.82mm. Note:…
